id: 32_Safety Quiz for Safety Officer Test Your Safety Knowledge Safety Quiz Safety Qui
title: 安全员十问：施工安全基础
source_doc: course/Laboratory Ergonomics & RSI/32_Safety Quiz for Safety Officer Test Your Safety Knowledge Safety Quiz Safety Qui.md
author_source: project/Laboratory Ergonomics & RSI/32_Safety Quiz for Safety Officer Test Your Safety Knowledge Safety Quiz Safety Qui/src.py

points.K1: 测验目的：找出薄弱环节
points.K2: 美国职业安全卫生监管机构
points.K7: 防坠落计划为了不坠落

shots.scene: 欣欣戴安全帽、护目镜和反光背心，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot wearing a safety helmet, goggles and a reflective vest waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 安全员十问，测测施工安全基础！
overlay: 安全员十问：施工安全基础

shots.scene: 一行图标：安全帽、护目镜、耳罩、反光背心
shots.prompt_en: A row of icons: a hard hat, goggles, ear muffs and a reflective vest. No people.
shots.narration: 十道选择题，每题都有答案和解释。

shots.scene: 工地培训室，阿杰和几名新安全员坐好
shots.prompt_en: In a site training room, the young male student and a few new safety officers sit down.
shots.narration: 工地上来了几位新安全员。

shots.scene: 王老师站在白板前，手拿空白题单
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator stands at a whiteboard holding a blank quiz sheet.
shots.narration: 王老师：先做十道题，摸摸底。

shots.section_title: 测验目的：找出薄弱环节
shots.scene: 放大镜照着一张知识地图，有一块空白
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass over a knowledge map with one blank patch. No people.
shots.narration: 测验评估你对安全做法的理解，
overlay: 测验目的：找出薄弱环节

shots.section_title: 测验目的：找出薄弱环节
shots.scene: 空白区域亮起问号
shots.prompt_en: The blank patch lights up with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 找出薄弱环节，再重点补上。

shots.section_title: 测验目的：找出薄弱环节
shots.scene: 十道题，每题四个选项
shots.prompt_en: Ten question cards, each with four option boxes. No people.
shots.narration: 十道选择题，四选一，答完有解释。

shots.section_title: 美国职业安全卫生监管机构
shots.scene: 一面美国国旗图标和一座政府楼
shots.prompt_en: A government building icon with a small United States flag. No people.
shots.narration: 第一题：美国职业安全卫生管理局全称？
overlay: 美国职业安全卫生监管机构

shots.section_title: 美国职业安全卫生监管机构
shots.scene: 四张选项卡片
shots.prompt_en: Four option cards with icons. No people.
shots.narration: 四个英文全称，只有一个对。

shots.section_title: 美国职业安全卫生监管机构
shots.scene: 正确选项卡片亮起并打勾
shots.prompt_en: The correct option card lights up with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案A，职业安全与卫生管理局。

shots.section_title: 美国职业安全卫生监管机构
shots.scene: 政府楼盖章
shots.prompt_en: The government building icon stamps a rule book. No people.
shots.narration: 它是美国联邦机构，制定和执行职场安全法规。

shots.scene: 坠落、触电、物体打击、危险物质四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a fall, an electric shock, a falling object and a hazardous chemical. No people.
shots.narration: 第二题：哪个不属于施工四大致命伤害？

shots.scene: 坠落、触电、物体打击三个图标亮红
shots.prompt_en: The fall, electric shock and falling object icons glow red. No people.
shots.narration: 坠落、触电、物体打击都在其中，

shots.scene: 挤压图标加入，危险物质图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: A caught-between icon joins them, and the hazardous chemical icon gets a check. No people.
shots.narration: 第四类是挤压夹入。答案D，危险物质接触。

shots.scene: 危险物质图标旁一个感叹号
shots.prompt_en: An exclamation mark beside the hazardous chemical icon. No people.
shots.narration: 它也很重要，但不属于四大类。

shots.scene: 沟槽里放着一个支护箱
shots.prompt_en: A trench box placed in a trench. No people.
shots.narration: 第三题：沟槽支护箱的主要用途？

shots.scene: 放工具、遮阳、撑沟壁、防雨四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a toolbox, a sun shade, braced trench walls and a rain cloud. No people.
shots.narration: 放工具、遮阳、撑住沟壁、防雨水。

shots.scene: 正确选项卡片亮起并打勾
shots.prompt_en: The correct option card lights up with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案C，支撑沟壁、防止坍塌。

shots.scene: 支护箱里的人形图标安全
shots.prompt_en: A person icon stands safely inside the trench box. No people.
shots.narration: 它撑住沟壁，保护沟里的工人。

shots.scene: 油桶旁起火
shots.prompt_en: A fire next to an oil drum. No people.
shots.narration: 第四题：有易燃液体的场所用哪类灭火器？

shots.scene: 正确选项卡片亮起并打勾
shots.prompt_en: The correct option card lights up with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案B，B类灭火器。

shots.scene: 汽油罐和油瓶图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a gasoline can and an oil bottle. No people.
shots.narration: B类专门对付汽油、油类这样的液体火。

shots.scene: 受限空间入口和空白许可证
shots.prompt_en: A confined space entry hatch with a blank permit form. No people.
shots.narration: 第五题：什么时候需要受限空间进入许可？

shots.scene: 四张选项卡片
shots.prompt_en: Four option cards with icons: a toxic cloud, any condition, a big box and a supervisor. No people.
shots.narration: 有危险气体时？任何情况？容积大时？

shots.scene: 任何情况、容积、主管三张卡片打叉
shots.prompt_en: The any condition, volume and supervisor cards are crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 不论条件、超100立方英尺、主管进，都不对。

shots.scene: 正确选项卡片亮起并打勾
shots.prompt_en: The correct option card lights up with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案A，存在或可能存在危险气体时。

shots.section_title: 防坠落计划为了不坠落
shots.scene: 高处作业的工人和安全带图标
shots.prompt_en: A worker at height with a harness icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第六题：防坠落计划的首要目的？
overlay: 防坠落计划为了不坠落

shots.section_title: 防坠落计划为了不坠落
shots.scene: 防坠、急救、上报、调查四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a shield, a first aid kit, a report and a magnifier. No people.
shots.narration: 防止坠落？事后急救？上报？查原因？

shots.section_title: 防坠落计划为了不坠落
shots.scene: 正确选项卡片亮起并打勾
shots.prompt_en: The correct option card lights up with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案A，防止坠落发生。

shots.section_title: 防坠落计划为了不坠落
shots.scene: 计划里有措施、装备、程序三个图标
shots.prompt_en: A plan with three icons: measures, equipment and procedures. No people.
shots.narration: 计划写明安全措施、装备和程序。

shots.scene: 工地上一圈人围着开会
shots.prompt_en: A circle of workers holding a short meeting at a site. No people.
shots.narration: 第七题：班前会什么时候开？

shots.scene: 四张选项卡片
shots.prompt_en: Four option cards with calendar icons. No people.
shots.narration: 半年一次？新人入职？新项目前？每天？

shots.scene: 新人入职卡片旁一本培训手册
shots.prompt_en: A training manual next to the new worker card. No people.
shots.narration: 新人入职那是入场教育，不是班前会。

shots.scene: 正确选项卡片亮起并打勾
shots.prompt_en: The correct option card lights up with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案D，每个工作日或班次开始前。

shots.scene: 会上的危害图标和讨论气泡
shots.prompt_en: Hazard icons and discussion bubbles at the meeting. No people.
shots.narration: 会上讲安全话题，识别当天的危害。

shots.scene: 配电柜上挂锁和标签
shots.prompt_en: A padlock and a tag on an electrical panel. No people.
shots.narration: 第八题：上锁挂牌的首要目的？

shots.scene: 夜间锁门、防止乱碰、隔离能量、交通
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a night lock, a no-touch hand, an isolated power switch and traffic cones. No people.
shots.narration: 夜间锁场、防乱碰、隔离能量、管交通。

shots.scene: 正确选项卡片亮起并打勾
shots.prompt_en: The correct option card lights up with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案C，隔离能量源。

shots.scene: 检修工人旁机器保持停止
shots.prompt_en: A machine stays stopped while a worker icon repairs it. No people.
shots.narration: 检修时防止设备意外启动，保护作业人员。

shots.scene: 空白多页文件，封面化学瓶图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank multi-page document with a chemical bottle icon on the cover. No people.
shots.narration: 第九题：这份数据表的缩写代表什么？

shots.scene: 正确选项卡片亮起并打勾
shots.prompt_en: The correct option card lights up with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案A，物质安全数据表。

shots.scene: 文件打开，性质和危害图标
shots.prompt_en: The document opens to show property and hazard icons. No people.
shots.narration: 它介绍化学品的性质和健康安全危害。

shots.scene: 沟槽侧壁做成斜坡
shots.prompt_en: A trench with sloped side walls. No people.
shots.narration: 第十题：开挖放坡是什么意思？

shots.scene: 装饰、放坡、绿化、刷漆四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a decorative pattern, a sloped trench, plants and a paint brush. No people.
shots.narration: 做装饰？放坡防塌？加绿化？刷涂层？

shots.scene: 正确选项卡片亮起并打勾
shots.prompt_en: The correct option card lights up with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案B，把沟壁做成斜坡，防止塌方。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在白板前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at a whiteboard.
shots.narration: 四大伤害：坠落、触电、打击、挤压。

shots.scene: 支护箱和放坡图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a trench box and a sloped trench. No people.
shots.narration: 支护箱撑沟壁，放坡防塌方。

shots.scene: 锁具、灭火器、班前会图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a padlock, an extinguisher and a toolbox meeting. No people.
shots.narration: 上锁隔离能量，B类灭液体火，班前会天天开。

shots.scene: 王老师发下题单文件
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator hands out the quiz sheet.
shots.narration: 这份题单也可以拿去办安全竞赛。

shots.scene: 欣欣挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 安全员十问到这里，下次见！
